answer: In a decentralized AI economy, the Falcon-based reputation system can resist Sybil attacks by requiring agents to demonstrate a certain level of performance and reputation across multiple, diverse tasks, much like a falcon's impressive hunting prowess is measured by its ability to catch a variety of prey across different environments. This approach assigns a unique, non-umber-based reputation score to each agent, taking into account its performance across a diverse set of tasks, effectively limiting the ability of malicious agents to create fake identities and manipulate the economy's horizon.
